title: Fused ultrametric Gromov-Wasserstein for Scenario Tree generation in Multistage Stochastic Programming
summary: Multistage Stochastic Programming requires scenario trees that accurately approximate the unknown underlying uncertainty process without violating the non-anticipativity constraint. Most of the existing method for scenario tree generation usually target just one of the two goals at the expense of the other, and just some recent methods try to simultaneously address both.
